# CLAUDE.md

## Overview

Bundled web fonts for cross-platform typography consistency.

## Index

| File                          | Contents (WHAT)                                  | Read When (WHEN)                          |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| `Inter-Regular.woff2`         | Inter Regular 400 weight web font                | Updating UI font, debugging font loading  |
| `Inter-Medium.woff2`          | Inter Medium 500 weight web font                 | Updating UI font, debugging font loading  |
| `Inter-SemiBold.woff2`        | Inter SemiBold 600 weight web font               | Updating UI font, debugging font loading  |
| `JetBrainsMono-Regular.woff2` | JetBrains Mono Regular 400 weight monospace font | Updating code font, debugging font loading |
